title: maps_app
description: What maps.py hands the mounted Maps app: the page menu's event, the site's command dialog settings, and the list layout its page menu offers the other of. Everything else the app shows it fetches.

page_menu_event.description: The DOM event the map list's page menu entries dispatch, with the action as its detail.

list_layout.title: MapListLayout
list_layout.description: The layout the map list is shown in, as the server-rendered page menu has it.

maps_command_settings.title: MapsCommandSettings
maps_command_settings.description: How the site has the acknowledge and downtime dialogs set up, as the monitoring pages hand it to theirs.
